blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Faster increases in transport costs pushed inflation higher in Cebu Province and its highly urbanized cities (HUCs) in October 2026, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) 7. Cebu Province recorded an overall inflation rate of 11.4 percent in October, up from 9.2 percent in September. Cebu City likewise posted higher inflation at 8.9 percent, compared with 8.4 percent in the previous month. Lapu-Lapu City’s inflation rate rose to 5.2 percent, while Mandaue City recorded 7.3 percent, up from 6.8 percent in September.
